description: A Replay Vision scanner: its type, targeting query, and AI configuration.

credit_limit.description: Optional cap on this scanner's own credit spend per billing period. Null means no scanner-level cap. When reached, this scanner stops scanning until the period resets. It stays enabled and does not scan the sessions it skipped.

description.description: Free-form description shown in the scanner management UI.

emits_signals.description: When true, the prompt is augmented with the Signal side mission and the scanner emits PostHog Signals.

enabled.description: When false, the reconciler removes the scanner's Temporal schedule. On-demand triggers still work.

anyOf.description:
The experiment a scanner watches. Scans derive their person-scoped exposure filter from
this blob at query time, so it is the only place an experiment can enter a scanner's
targeting — which is what lets the write-side access check and read-side redaction cover it.

variant.description: Narrow to sessions of people exposed to this variant. Null means every variant.

experiment_targeting.description: The experiment this scanner's targeting watches, if any. Set null when the experiment targeting is removed.

model.description:
Concrete model to use for this scanner.

* `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` - Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite
* `gemini-3-flash-preview` - Gemini 3 Flash
* `gemini-3.7-flash` - Gemini 3.7 Flash

name.description: Human-readable scanner name. Unique within the team.

provider.description:
LLM provider. v1 is Google-only.

* `google` - Google

query.description: Persisted `RecordingsQuery` shape used to pick candidate sessions. `date_from`/`date_to` are stripped on save — the schedule controls time, not the user.

sampling_mode.description:
Quality pre-filter applied before random sampling. focused = top sessions only, balanced = drops the lowest-quality, comprehensive = no filter (default).

* `focused` - Focused
* `balanced` - Balanced
* `comprehensive` - Comprehensive

sampling_rate.description: 0..1 random downsample applied after the query matches. Defaults to 1.0 (no downsampling). Use exactly 0 to pause scanning; non-zero rates below 0.0001 (0.01%) are rejected as below the sampling precision.

scanner_config.description: Type-specific configuration. All scanner types require `prompt`; monitors add optional `allow_inconclusive`, classifiers add `tags`, scorers add `scale`, summarizers add optional `length`.

scanner_type.description:
What the scanner does: monitor, classifier, scorer, or summarizer.

* `monitor` - Monitor
* `classifier` - Classifier
* `scorer` - Scorer
* `summarizer` - Summarizer

tags.description: Organizational tags for this scanner. Distinct from a classifier's categories in scanner_config. Tags cannot contain commas.
